group.name: Frontend (API handler) <-> Backend REST API
group.modules: public/api.js (apiRequest) + public/main.js  <->  src/app.js (Express routes) -> auth/products modules
group.strategy: Top-Down Integration: the top layer (frontend API handler) is tested first against the real backend routes; the DB is replaced by the seeded in-memory store (stub).
group.dataPassed: HTTP JSON requests (method, JSON body, Bearer token)  ->  JSON responses {ok, status, products|token|user|errors}

cases.title: Frontend loads product list from backend
cases.objective: Verify the frontend request handler and the Express backend exchange data correctly over real HTTP
cases.pre: Express server started on random port; DB seeded with 3 products
cases.steps: 1. Prepare state (see Preconditions)  2. Perform the actions listed in Test Data  3. Compare the output with Expected Result
cases.expected: status 200, 3 products (Wireless Mouse, Mechanical Keyboard, USB-C Cable)
cases.actual: status 200, 3 products (Wireless Mouse, Mechanical Keyboard, USB-C Cable)

cases.title: Register + login through frontend returns a session token
cases.objective: Verify the frontend request handler and the Express backend exchange data correctly over real HTTP
cases.pre: Express server started on random port; DB seeded with 3 products
cases.steps: 1. Prepare state (see Preconditions)  2. Perform the actions listed in Test Data  3. Compare the output with Expected Result
cases.expected: register 201; login 200 with 48-char token and user.name="Ali Khan"
cases.actual: register 201; login 200, token length 48, user.name="Ali Khan"

cases.title: Backend validation errors reach the frontend unchanged
cases.objective: Verify the frontend request handler and the Express backend exchange data correctly over real HTTP
cases.pre: Express server started on random port; DB seeded with 3 products
cases.steps: 1. Prepare state (see Preconditions)  2. Perform the actions listed in Test Data  3. Compare the output with Expected Result
cases.expected: status 400 with name, email and password error messages
cases.actual: status 400, errors=["Name must be at least 2 characters","Invalid email format","Password must be at least 8 characters","Password must contain an uppercase letter","Password must contain a lowercase letter"]
